name: Medal of Honor: 10th Anniversary Edition
summary:
Medal of Honor – 10th Anniversary Edition is a compilation celebrating the first decade of the Medal of Honor series. It brings together several World War II–themed first-person shooters covering different theaters of the war, including Europe and the Pacific.

The collection allows players to experience campaigns set during major historical events, such as the Normandy landings, the attack on Pearl Harbor, and the final advance toward Berlin. It includes both single-player and multiplayer content across the featured titles.

Included games:
Medal of Honor: Allied Assault
Medal of Honor: Allied Assault – Spearhead
Medal of Honor: Allied Assault – Breakthrough
Medal of Honor: Pacific Assault
Medal of Honor: Airborne
